name: Analytic Integration for Trilinear Variation
definition: Analytical integration of a cubic polynomial representing the trilinear basis function along a line segment within a voxel, used to compute the contribution of voxel corners to the ray integral.
summary: Analytic Integration for Trilinear Variation computes the exact integral of a scalar field varying according to a trilinear basis function along a ray segment, avoiding aliasing errors inherent in numerical quadrature.
